name: facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/env_hum.create_env_instance: create a humanoid simulation environment instance by passing a config dictionary with character, state, reward, and action settings
facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/env_hum.compute_reward: compute the reward for an agent using task-specific errors and a reward definition tree with add, mul, min, max, or leaf operations
facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/env_hum.compute_target_pose: compute a target pose for a simulated agent from a denormalized action vector using absolute or relative action mode
facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/env_hum.inspect_end_of_episode: inspect whether end-of-episode conditions are met by checking falldown, simulation divergence, time window, low reward, or out-of-ground events
facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/env_hum.render_environment: render the humanoid simulation environment with optional target pose overlay and kinematic model visualization using OpenGL

facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/env_hum.create_humanoid_imitation_env: create a humanoid imitation environment by instantiating Env with a config dict containing project_dir and character settings
facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/env_hum.build_env_create: build the imitation environment setup by calling create to load reference motions and initialize agents
facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/env_hum.test_get_task_error: test the get_task_error method to compute pose velocity and end effector error between simulated and kinematic agents
facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/env_hum.review_state_imitation: review the state_imitation method to understand how absolute relative and facing frame states are computed for imitation
facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/env_hum.summarize_sample_ref_motion: summarize the sample_ref_motion method which randomly selects reference motions for each agent from the loaded motion database

facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/env_hum.create_Env: create a humanoid simulation environment by instantiating Env with a config dict specifying character URDF, physics params, and ground settings
facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/env_hum.step_simulation: step the simulation forward one control timestep by calling env.step with an optional list of action dicts for each agent
facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/env_hum.reset_environment: reset the simulation to initial state by calling env.reset with optional time, poses, velocities, or a saved pybullet state ID
facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/env_hum.check_falldown: check if an agent has fallen by calling env.check_falldown with the agent index, using either collision-based or height-based detection methods
facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/env_hum.get_ground_height: get the ground height at an agent position by calling env.get_ground_height with the agent index, supporting height maps and raycasting

facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/rllib_e.create_HumanoidImitation_env: create a HumanoidImitation gym environment from an env_config dict for humanoid imitation learning
facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/rllib_e.run_EnvRunner_one_step: run a single environment step using EnvRunner with optional exploration and policy evaluation method
facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/rllib_e.generate_state_action_pairs: generate and save state-action pairs from a trained RLlib policy to a pickle file
facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/rllib_e.render_with_EnvRenderer: render the humanoid imitation environment with replay support and camera following using EnvRenderer
facebookresearch_physicsvae/envs/rllib_e.override_config_for_env: override the RLlib config with observation spaces from a HumanoidImitation environment using config_override
